description: Abstract class 'CacheStrategy' defining cache point determination logic, token calculations, message conversions, and cache application for AI message handling.

classes.name: CacheStrategy
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods for cache point management, token estimation, and message processing in AI systems.

methods.name: determineOptimalCachePoints
methods.description: Abstract method to determine cache points, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.description: Initializes message groups from input messages.

methods.description: Calculates token count for system prompt with detailed estimation.

methods.description: Creates a cache point content block.
